respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture comprises two main workflows: code deployment and runtime execution. For deployment, customer developers use a CLI to deploy code to an EC2 web service, which stores state in DynamoDB and enqueues deployment tasks into an SQS queue. A backend EC2 worker reads tasks from SQS and creates Lambda functions. For runtime execution, an end-user Browser requests page fragments from internal services running on EC2, which invokes the corresponding Lambda function and returns the rendered content back to the Browser. The illegible visual box b1 is resolved to Browser based on narration mentioning 'CLI and browser'. ALB mentioned in passing without an edge is omitted.
